objective: Develop a risk-manager-facing narrative-conditioned, support-grounded latent scenario generator for the frozen joint39 SNI generator. The user narrative describes current or recent market conditions; the risk manager must manually select a historical/current joint39 start or provide an explicit joint39 start before any narrative-conditioned mixture is formed. The long-term research objective is a novel, publishable text/start-conditioned support prior over historical prefixes or prototypes: language shapes an auditable distribution over on-manifold support, and the frozen SNI generator produces the 30-day scenario distribution.

incumbent_benchmark.name: soft_topk_narrative_start_checked / narrative_generator_topk
incumbent_benchmark.distributional_floor: New methods must be at least competitive with the simple mixture on ensemble CRPS, energy score, and 80% coverage before promotion. A small regression is acceptable only if it buys clear trust, stability, or conditionality gains and is documented as a trade-off.
incumbent_benchmark.non_promotion_rule: Do not promote methods that materially regress below the simple mixture while only improving retrieval rank, target cosine, or an isolated diagnostic.

research_lanes.exploration: Cheap mechanism-seeking tests may regress, including severe regression, if the result is low cost and explains whether to continue, change, or kill the branch.
research_lanes.candidate: A plausible method may tolerate moderate regression only when the trade-off and falsifier were stated before the run.
research_lanes.promotion: A candidate must be competitive with the simple mixture on held-out scenario metrics, support audits, fixed-start controls, and null or repeat checks before it changes defaults or paper claims.
research_lanes.production_demo: User-facing defaults may not drastically regress; small regressions require a visible trust, warning, OOD, provenance, or fixed-start stability benefit.

sophisticated_method_gate.method_story: Explain how the method turns a risk-manager narrative plus fixed start into an auditable support mixture.
sophisticated_method_gate.related_work_basis: Cite primary related work or first-principles local evidence supporting the design family.
sophisticated_method_gate.novelty_claim: State what is new relative to CLIP-style alignment, retrieval/RAG, text-to-time-series generation, and financial scenario generation.
sophisticated_method_gate.elegance_check: Explain why the added component is necessary and not just another knob.
sophisticated_method_gate.backtest_gate: Compare same-seed held-out historical backtests against the simple mixture floor using CRPS, energy, coverage, fixed-start controls, null/repeat checks, and support audits.
sophisticated_method_gate.kill_condition: State the result that stops the branch before launching the run.

first_gate: Promoted fixed-start narrative conditioning claims must include tracked case specs, artifact paths, verifier report, fixed-start equality, support-direction checks, per-start quality, null or repeat baselines, and start-damping diagnostics before production promotion.
